en.t: “I cannot tell by touch, but...” she said,

units.source_text: 她再次拿出那只女人使用嫌大了点的银表，打开盖子，

en.t: and once again took out the silver watch, a little too large for a woman to use, and opened the cover,

units.source_text: 用手指按着让岛村看：这里是十二点，这里是六点，它们中间是三点。

en.t: pressing it with her finger to show Shimamura: this is twelve o’clock, this is six o’clock, and halfway between them is three o’clock.

units.source_text: “然后推算，虽然不能一分钟不差，但也错不了两分钟。”

en.t: “Then I work it out from there. It may not be accurate to the exact minute, but it cannot be off by two minutes.”
